title: GCS Storage Bucket Module
description: Provisions one or more Google Cloud Storage buckets. The input is a map where each key is the bucket name (globally unique) and each value is a configuration object.

storage_bucket_config.description: Configuration for a single GCS Bucket.

location.description: Bucket location. Can be a multi-region (e.g. 'US', 'EU'), dual-region (e.g. 'NAM4'), or region (e.g. 'us-central1').

project.description: Project ID to create the bucket in. Leave empty to use the provider's default project.

storage_class.description: Storage class for objects in the bucket.

force_destroy.description: When true, allows `terraform destroy` to delete the bucket even if it contains objects. Keep false in production.

uniform_bucket_level_access.description: When true, disables ACLs and uses IAM exclusively. Recommended.

versioning.description: When true, enables object versioning on the bucket.

labels.description: Key-value labels applied to the bucket.

retention_days.description: When > 0, attaches a retention policy preventing objects from being deleted for this many days. 0 disables.

lifecycle_age_days.description: When > 0, adds a lifecycle rule that deletes objects older than this many days. 0 disables.

key_spec.label: bucket name
key_spec.description: Globally-unique GCS bucket name across ALL of Google Cloud Storage. 3-63 chars. Must start and end with a lowercase letter or digit. May contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, underscores, and periods. This is the bucket name only — location and project are separate prompts below.
